name: HIGH_PRIEST_GOLD_GARMENTS
canonical: the ornate golden vestments of the Hebrew high priest displayed on a plain wooden stand with NO person wearing them and NO head or face at all, NO Egyptian Pharaoh nemes headdress: a blue robe hemmed with bells and pomegranates, a gold-threaded ephod, and a jewelled breastplate of twelve gemstones, and resting above the robe a Hebrew priestly white linen turban/mitre with a small gold plate; garments of gold and glory, NOT plain linen, NOT a bishop's mitre or cope, NOT Egyptian
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
